lore_so_far: Drop 1 (reveal): Bounti HQ's first ever bounty. As a boy he was a deckhand on a crew nobody remembers, and no one ever looked at him twice, so he bit a Curse Coin.
His Echo Coin turns one shout into ten thousand; every headline you could not scroll past and every 'YOU WON'T BELIEVE THIS' was his voice.
The price: he can never earn an honest coin again, so he sells noise. Last seen shouting from three harbours at once; his fleet is loud, cheap and very confident.

Drop 2 (reveal): for three years he ran the friendliest earning circle on the Open Sea, answered every question, welcomed every new hunter by name, and politely collected a small 'membership fee' from each. Nobody asked where the fees went.
One morning the circle woke up to nothing: no messages, no records, no admin. His Vanish Coin makes anything he wants gone disappear, and he made all of it vanish, himself included.
Last seen pushing his glasses up with one long nail, saying 'Right on schedule.' He cannot stand a plan that goes off script.

Drop 3 (reveal): her empire is a glittering ship with a thousand doors, out past the busy harbours. Every door is an invitation: free gifts, secret drops, 'You've been selected.' Hunters who step through never come back; their crews just stop hearing from them.
Her Lure Coin makes anything she sends look irresistible. Last week a whole crew followed one shiny invite to 'claim their spot'; nobody has seen them since, and the spots were never real.
Rumoured backstory: once the plainest girl on her island, laughed out of every room. She bit the coin so no one would ever look past her again. Her weakness is being ignored.
